integrity: Finite tree certificate included; verification from graph adjacency independently replays the certificate and evaluates small cases. General statements are mathematically proved, not extrapolated from these computations.
scientific_limitations: Static wheel-cycle VC dimension is prior work (Mofidi 2022); this finding establishes adaptive bounds and a first gap, not a complete exact formula for larger rims. Historical priority is only compared to accessible primary literature and records; independent audit not performed. The date refers to the first dated arXiv v1 of the cited theoretical background; earlier 2022 wheel article is indexed month-only.
title: An unbounded adaptive gap at fixed VC dimension for simple cycles of wheels
